title: Saying What You'd Like To Do: szeretném + Infinitive

sections.content: szeretném is the conditional 'I would like' used with a specific action in mind; it pairs with an infinitive (ending in -ni) to say what you'd like to do. felpróbálni ('to try on') is built from próbál ('to try') with the prefix fel- ('up/on').

items.english: I would like to try on the shoe.
I would like to try on the coat.

sections.content: felpróbálni packs both 'try' and 'on' into one word via the prefix fel-. Keep the prefix attached to the infinitive here -- separating it ('fel próbálni') is wrong in this construction.
